title: J-lens fit convergence versus fit-corpus size
research_question: Do fitted Jacobian lenses converge as the fit corpus grows from 10 to 25 prompts?
caption_draft: Relative Frobenius difference and flattened cosine similarity between the 10-prompt and 25-prompt fitted Jacobian matrices, by source layer.
limitations: Engineering convergence only. Convergence does not establish that the lens is scientifically valid or that its outputs are semantically meaningful.

title: Shard-merge versus direct-subset fit consistency
research_question: Does sharded fitting followed by merge reproduce a directly fitted lens?
caption_draft: Per-layer agreement between the merged 3-shard lens and a directly fitted lens over the same 25 prompts.
limitations: Purely a numerical reproducibility check of the fitting pipeline.

title: Apply-logit stability on held-out generic prompts
research_question: Is lens application numerically stable on prompts not used for fitting?
caption_draft: Top-k overlap and rank correlation between repeated lens applications on held-out generic prompts.
limitations: Top-k overlap is a technical stability statistic only. It is never evidence about semantics, hidden reasoning, or internal representations.

title: Per-cell capability headroom
research_question: Which task family x difficulty cells leave the target model measurable headroom?
caption_draft: Adjudicated semantic accuracy with Wilson 95% confidence intervals for each of the 15 task-family x difficulty cells, under visible_cot and r1_style_thinking.
limitations: n=10 per cell, so this is a SCREEN and never a stable performance estimate; a 7/10 cell's interval spans [0.397, 0.892]. Only 10 of 30 cells have a plotted accuracy at all, because a cell containing any unresolved row is not scored. Single sample per item and condition; this screens tasks and does not estimate pass@k.

title: Independent-fit disagreement between two disjoint 25-prompt J-lenses
research_question: How far do two same-size J-lenses fitted on disjoint prompt samples differ?
caption_draft: Per-layer relative Frobenius distance and cosine between 25A and 25B and between each single fit and their 25/25 weighted merge| for source layers 6| 13 and 20.
limitations: Two fits give one difference| not a distribution. The merged lens is a weighted mean of the two plotted endpoints| so its near-equal distance to both is arithmetically expected and is not evidence of convergence; see L-18.

title: Held-out apply stability across 25A| 25B and the merged 50-prompt lens
research_question: Does the merged lens behave numerically like a well-formed lens on prompts used by neither fit?
caption_draft: Top-k overlap and Spearman rank correlation over 10 held-out prompts for each of the three lens pairs| with the preregistered improvement margins marked.
limitations: Top-k overlap and rank correlation are technical stability statistics only. They are never evidence about semantics| hidden reasoning| or internal representations. The improvement of the merged pairs over the single-fit pair is close to arithmetically forced; see L-18.
